metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name with Microsoft Sentinel enabled
Rules deploy disabled by default so they can be reviewed first

properties.displayName: Mass deletion of Azure resources by one identity
properties.description: One caller deletes an unusual number of Azure resources in a short window. Covers destructive insider actions and compromised automation credentials.
properties.query:
let window = 1h;
let minDeletes = 10;
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(window)
| where OperationNameValue endswith "/DELETE"
| where ActivityStatusValue in ("Success", "Succeeded")
| summarize Deletes = count(), ResourceTypes = make_set(ResourceProviderValue, 10),
            Resources = make_set(_ResourceId, 20), ResourceGroups = make_set(ResourceGroup, 10),
            FirstDelete = min(TimeGenerated), LastDelete = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Caller, CallerIpAddress, SubscriptionId
| where Deletes >= minDeletes

properties.displayName: Network security group rule opens a management port to the internet
properties.description: An NSG security rule is created or updated to allow RDP, SSH, WinRM, or SMB from any source. One of the most common causes of cloud compromise.
properties.query:
let mgmtPorts = dynamic(["22", "3389", "5985", "5986", "445", "*"]);
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where OperationNameValue =~ "MICROSOFT.NETWORK/NETWORKSECURITYGROUPS/SECURITYRULES/WRITE"
| where ActivityStatusValue in ("Success", "Succeeded")
| extend Req = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(Properties).requestbody)).properties
| extend Access = tostring(Req.access), Direction = tostring(Req.direction),
         Source = tostring(Req.sourceAddressPrefix), Port = tostring(Req.destinationPortRange)
| where Access =~ "Allow" and Direction =~ "Inbound"
| where Source in ("*", "0.0.0.0/0", "Internet", "Any")
| where Port in (mgmtPorts)
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, _ResourceId, Port, Source, Access

properties.displayName: User clicked through a URL later classified as malicious
properties.description: Safe Links allowed a click that Defender for Office 365 later (or at click time) identified as phishing or malware. These users need password reset and session revocation review.
properties.query:
UrlClickEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed", "UrlScanInProgress") or IsClickedThrough == true
| where ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware")
| join kind=leftouter (
    EmailEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2d)
    | project NetworkMessageId, Subject, SenderFromAddress, DeliveryAction
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| project Timestamp, AccountUpn, Url, ActionType, IsClickedThrough, ThreatTypes, Subject, SenderFromAddress, IPAddress

properties.displayName: Inbox rule forwards or redirects mail to an external address
properties.description: A mailbox rule is created or changed to forward, redirect, or delete mail, often to hide replies from the victim during business email compromise.
properties.query:
let internalDomains = dynamic(["contoso.com"]);   // replace with your accepted domains
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "UpdateInboxRules")
| extend Params = tostring(Parameters)
| where Params has_any ("ForwardTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo", "RedirectTo", "DeleteMessage", "MoveToFolder")
| extend ForwardAddress = extract(@"(?i)(?:ForwardTo|ForwardAsAttachmentTo|RedirectTo)""?,""Value"":""([^""]+)", 1, Params)
| extend ForwardDomain = tostring(split(ForwardAddress, "@")[1])
| where isempty(ForwardDomain) or not(ForwardDomain in~ (internalDomains))
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, ForwardAddress, ClientIP, Params

properties.displayName: PowerShell launched with an encoded command
properties.description: PowerShell started with -EncodedCommand (or a short alias of it). Encoding is a common way to hide download cradles and payloads from simple inspection. The rule decodes the payload so the analyst sees it immediately.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-e(nc|ncodedcommand|c)?\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}"
| extend Encoded = extract(@"(?i)\s-e(?:nc|ncodedcommand|c)?\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = replace_string(base64_decode_tostring(Encoded), "\u0000", "")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, ProcessCommandLine, Decoded, ReportId, DeviceId

properties.displayName: Credential dumping tool or LSASS dump via comsvcs.dll
properties.description: Detects the most common living-off-the-land LSASS dump (rundll32 calling comsvcs.dll MiniDump) and well-known credential dumping tool names or command-line markers.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump", "#24"))
     or (FileName in~ ("procdump.exe", "procdump64.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
     or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sekurlsa::", "lsadump::", "privilege::debug")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, ReportId, DeviceId

properties.displayName: Office application spawns a script interpreter or LOLBin
properties.description: Word, Excel, PowerPoint or Outlook launching cmd, PowerShell, script hosts, or common download/execution binaries. Typical of macro and exploit-based initial access.

properties.displayName: Many failed network logons followed by success from the same IP
properties.description: Brute force against RDP/SMB that eventually succeeds. Looks for a burst of failures from one remote IP to a device, then a successful logon from that IP.
properties.query:
let window = 1h;
let minFailures = 20;
let failures = DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(window)
    | where ActionType == "LogonFailed" and LogonType in ("Network", "RemoteInteractive")
    | where isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | summarize Failures = count(), FirstFail = min(Timestamp), TargetedAccounts = dcount(AccountName)
        by DeviceName, RemoteIP;
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(window)
| where ActionType == "LogonSuccess" and LogonType in ("Network", "RemoteInteractive")
| join kind=inner failures on DeviceName, RemoteIP
| where Failures >= minFailures and Timestamp > FirstFail
| summarize SuccessAt = min(Timestamp), Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 5)
    by DeviceName, RemoteIP, Failures, TargetedAccounts

properties.displayName: Successful sign-ins from two countries within a short window
properties.description: The same account signs in successfully from two different countries less than the configured number of hours apart. Simple, explainable alternative to a full velocity calculation.
properties.query:
let maxHours = 2;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType == "0"
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| where isnotempty(Country)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Country, IPAddress, AppDisplayName
| sort by UserPrincipalName asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend PrevUser = prev(UserPrincipalName), PrevCountry = prev(Country),
         PrevTime = prev(TimeGenerated), PrevIP = prev(IPAddress)
| where UserPrincipalName == PrevUser and Country != PrevCountry
| extend HoursApart = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, PrevTime) / 60.0
| where HoursApart < maxHours
| project UserPrincipalName, PrevCountry, PrevIP, PrevTime, Country, IPAddress, TimeGenerated, HoursApart, AppDisplayName

properties.displayName: MFA fatigue - repeated push denials followed by approval
properties.description: An account receives several MFA prompts it denies or ignores, then approves one. Common push-bombing pattern used after password theft.
properties.query:
let window = 1h;
let minDenied = 3;
// 500121 = strong auth failed (denied / timed out), 50074 = strong auth required
let denied = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(window)
    | where ResultType in ("500121", "50074")
    | summarize Denied = count(), FirstDenied = min(TimeGenerated), DeniedIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 5)
        by UserPrincipalName;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(window)
| where ResultType == "0" and AuthenticationRequirement == "multiFactorAuthentication"
| summarize ApprovedAt = min(TimeGenerated), ApprovedIP = any(IPAddress) by UserPrincipalName
| join kind=inner denied on UserPrincipalName
| where Denied >= minDenied and ApprovedAt > FirstDenied
| project UserPrincipalName, Denied, FirstDenied, ApprovedAt, ApprovedIP, DeniedIPs

properties.displayName: User consent to OAuth app with high-risk permissions
properties.description: A user grants consent to an application requesting mail, file, or directory access scopes. Illicit consent grants give attackers persistent API access that survives password resets.
properties.query:
let riskyScopes = dynamic(["Mail.Read", "Mail.ReadWrite", "Mail.Send", "Files.ReadWrite.All",
    "Sites.ReadWrite.All", "Directory.ReadWrite.All", "offline_access", "MailboxSettings.ReadWrite"]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where OperationName == "Consent to application"
| extend User = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend App = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| mv-expand Prop = TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties
| where tostring(Prop.displayName) == "ConsentAction.Permissions"
| extend Permissions = tostring(Prop.newValue)
| where Permissions has_any (riskyScopes)
| project TimeGenerated, User, App, Permissions, CorrelationId

properties.description: One source IP fails sign-in for many distinct accounts in a short window using bad-password errors. Classic low-and-slow spray pattern.
properties.query:
let window = 1h;
let minAccounts = 10;
// 50126 = invalid username or password, 50053 = account locked (smart lockout)
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(window)
| where ResultType in ("50126", "50053")
| summarize FailedAccounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
            Attempts = count(),
            SampleUsers = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 10),
            Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by IPAddress, Location = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| where FailedAccounts >= minAccounts
| order by FailedAccounts desc

properties.displayName: Privileged Entra ID role assigned outside PIM
properties.description: A highly privileged directory role is added directly to a user or service principal, rather than through a Privileged Identity Management activation.
properties.query:
let privilegedRoles = dynamic(["Global Administrator", "Privileged Role Administrator",
    "Security Administrator", "Exchange Administrator", "Application Administrator",
    "Cloud Application Administrator", "User Administrator", "Conditional Access Administrator"]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where OperationName == "Add member to role"
| extend Initiator = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName))
| mv-expand Target = TargetResources
| extend TargetName = coalesce(tostring(Target.userPrincipalName), tostring(Target.displayName))
| mv-expand Prop = Target.modifiedProperties
| where tostring(Prop.displayName) == "Role.DisplayName"
| extend Role = trim('"', tostring(Prop.newValue))
| where Role in (privilegedRoles)
| where Initiator !~ "MS-PIM"   // PIM activations are logged with the PIM service as initiator
| project TimeGenerated, Initiator, TargetName, Role, CorrelationId
